Strict True confirms handler completion; overload, expiry, startup abort, failure and callback errors are distinct from completed openings. Native held-price entry and complete runtime-shutdown probes verify nonblocking admission and owned drain. No financial buy/sell, quote/birth/risk/filter/sizing, 0.1 SOL amount, exit policy, model fitting/activation or historical data rewrite is added. admission_contract.owner: Exactly one runtime-created async opening consumer; no task, thread, disk state or provider action on module import
admission_contract.capacity: Default 64 pending addresses, including active work; configurable validated capacity 1 through 256
admission_contract.bytes: Per-request UTF-8 and structural budget, at most 2 MiB; preserve the original vector's separate snapshot semantics
admission_contract.time: Default 120-second per-handler async timeout and 120-second maximum queued wait; native cancellation cleanup can exceed the nominal deadline while owned IO drains
admission_contract.bootstrap: Do not start provider/checkpoint work before readiness; shutdown before readiness fails queued memory work without inventing observations
admission_contract.identity: Pending address deduplication retains the first detached request; actual durable instance/event ownership remains in the native handler/checkpoint
admission_contract.research_limits: Pending and already-open address union applies original global/per-regime caps without double counting; admission reads a detached IO-owned address snapshot
admission_contract.source: Original feature values and three proof attrs survive the research adapter and queue transport; model validation remains independently responsible for accepting their provenance
admission_contract.clock: Original decision T0 is not rebased; requested_at and shadow_open_latency_sec describe local admission/open availability, not provider freshness or a fill
admission_contract.shutdown: Supervision watches the opening owner; repeated cancellation drains the original active operation and readiness owner before stopped publication
admission_contract.durability: Memory admission is not durability. The existing atomic native state checkpoint is the first durable boundary; a pre-admission or memory-queue process crash can lose unacknowledged diagnostic work

limits: This removes a reproduced auxiliary wait from one actual entry-caller path; production throughput, profitable capture and latency/SLA are not measured

No historical portfolio, dataset, model, policy or registry is rewritten or activated
The historical isolated Windows original model/birth-input consistency failure cause remains unresolved despite passing later revisions
